item.description: Few designers are using their platform like Rachel Scott of Diotima is. This season, the Jamaican designer spoke of the perils of American imperialism and worked with refugees, leveling up once more.

item.title: When Barack and Michelle Obama Partied Like Antony and Cleopatra
item.description: The Obamas’ 2017 White House farewell party and Mark Antony and Cleopatra’s wedding were both a last dance before the world shifted beneath each couple’s feet. But when power is slipping away, a great party can become one last bid for narrative control.

item.description: Train Dreams and Adolescence swept the ceremony, which relocated from sunny Santa Monica to a Hollywood ballroom.
